label: classifyPrompt suppresses Gate 3 on a write prompt when a read-only token (review/audit/inspect/analyze/explain) appears after the write verb: 'Update the README and review the result.' and 'Create a review checklist for the release.' both return triggersGate3=false with reason=read_only_override, contradicting AGENTS.md line 75 ('A read-only word next to a write trigger does not disqualify it').
verify: bun -e "import { classifyPrompt } from './.skilled/skills/system-spec-kit/shared/gate-3-classifier.ts'; console.log(classifyPrompt('Create a review checklist for the release.'))"

label: The v4.0.0.0 note says the completion gate grew a scope-adherence check driven by SYSTEM_SCOPE_CHANGED_FILES and SYSTEM_SCOPE_BASE, but validator-registry.json lists 42 rules and none is SCOPE_ADHERENCE; a grep of runtime/cli finds those env vars only in retrieval/fixtures/phrase-variants.json. Either the check lives outside the audited surface or it is not wired into validate.sh.

The READ_ONLY_DISQUALIFIERS comment says disqualifiers apply only when present WITHOUT a corresponding file-write trigger, but the file-write branch suppresses Gate 3 whenever any disqualifier matches and hasMixedWriteTail is false, including when the write verb comes first; the helper only examines read-only-before-write pairs.
verify: bun -e "import { classifyPrompt } from './.skilled/skills/system-spec-kit/shared/gate-3-classifier.ts'; console.log(classifyPrompt('Update the README and review the result.'))"

label: A prompt whose primary action is a file write must trigger Gate 3 regardless of a trailing read-only noun.
